name: wp-simple-access-control
description: Restrict access to single contents and to single blocks by user role.

scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/languages/wp-simple-access-control.pot --domain=wp-simple-access-control --exclude=node_modules,vendor,build,tools
scripts.i18n:po: wp-env run cli wp i18n update-po wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/languages/wp-simple-access-control.pot wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/languages
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/languages
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-json wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/languages --no-purge --use-map=wp-content/plugins/wp-simple-access-control/tools/i18n-map.json
